product.name: Vulcan OmniPro 220 Multiprocess Welding System
product.input: Dual voltage: 120VAC or 240VAC, 60 Hz (dedicated cord for each; plug only fits one way)

MIG.weldableMaterials: Mild steel, stainless steel, aluminum (with optional spool gun)

TIG.weldableMaterials: Mild steel, stainless steel, chrome moly (DC TIG only — no AC TIG, so no aluminum TIG)

dutyCycle.definition: Minutes of welding allowed within a 10-minute period at a given current without overheating (pages 19, 29). Thermal protection auto-shuts down on overheat and shows a warning screen; welder returns to service after cooling. Leave power ON while cooling so the fan runs.

MIG_solid_core_gas.name: DCEP (Direct Current Electrode Positive)
MIG_solid_core_gas.gas: Required — see settings chart inside door; C25 common for steel, Stainless Tri-Mix for stainless; 20-30 SCFH

TIG.name: DCEN (torch negative)
TIG.accessories: TIG torch and foot pedal sold separately; foot pedal connects to Foot Pedal Socket inside welder; leave wire feed power disconnected

polarity.note: Cables twist clockwise all the way to lock. Polarity screen on LCD shows correct hookup per process (page 20).

feedRoller.rule: Flip/replace roller so the number showing matches the wire diameter on the spool; V-groove for solid, knurled for flux-cored

wireFeed.stickout: Cut wire to 1/2" from tip (1/2" stickout); CTWD under 1/2" while welding
wireFeed.driveTensionTest: Feed wire against wood 2-3" away; wire should bend, not stop. Wire stops feeding 3 seconds after trigger press with no arc (page 17)

typical.mildSteel: C25 (75% Argon / 25% CO2); C100 needs the included CGA 580/320 adapter

tig.grind: Grind parallel to length; conical tip 2-2.5x electrode diameter; dedicated grinding wheel
tig.torchAngle: Tilt 10-15 degrees back from vertical once puddle forms

stick.arcStart: Tap, stroke, or strike like a match; then lift off the workpiece the same distance as the bare-metal end diameter, tilt back 10-20 degrees, drag to the back of the puddle

MIG_Flux: Run-In WFS (% of preset wire feed speed before wire contacts work)
Inductance (increase = more fluid puddle, flatter bead; decrease = colder puddle)
Stick: Hot Start (amperage boost at weld start)

power.outlet: Properly grounded, GFCI-protected 120VAC (20A rated) or 240VAC receptacle; delayed-action breaker or fuses; NO extension cords (pages 6, 16, 25)
power.resetButton: Overload protector Reset Button on back of machine (pages 43, 46)
